bio: This 400-year-old half-timbered building, which houses Hotel Höerhof and its charming restaurant, is a place where you feel at home. The combination of the historical setting and modern touches makes for a special atmosphere – in summer, make a beeline for the gorgeous terrace in the secluded courtyard! Morish dishes from the region are served here, as well as a gourmet set menu (Wed-Sat)....
